newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Berjaya to buy office space, hotel suites.
newsitem.headline: Berjaya to buy office space, hotel suites.

text.p: Berjaya Land Bhd, formerly Berjaya Leisure, said on Tuesday it proposed to buy office space and hotel facilities for 190.97 million ringgit.

The office space will be situated on the 13th floor of the group's Berjaya Star City development in Kuala Lumpur, while the hotel suites will be part of the company's hotel, also to be located within Star City.
"Star City, when completed in 1999, will be one of the largest integrated shopping, leisure and office complexes in Malaysia," said Berjaya Land.
The office space will cost 53.51 million ringgit, and the hotel suites 137.45 million ringgit.
Both will be bought from Berjaya Ditan Sdn Bhd, said Berjaya Land.
Berjaya Land stock had been suspended on Tuesday at 6.70 ringgit. The company did not say when the shares would be requoted.
